storyCards.headline: This Guy's In Love With You: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Herb Alpert's "This Guy's In Love With You" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.

This Guy's In Love With You was released in 1968.

"This Guy's In Love With You" by Herb Alpert.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
